name: AI Problem Solving Foundations
description: Representing problems using states, actions, initial state, goal test, and path cost.

name: Graph Basics
description: Nodes, edges, directed graphs, paths, and graph traversal.

name: Breadth-First Search (BFS)
description: Explores the frontier level by level, typically using a FIFO queue.

name: Depth-First Search (DFS)
description: Explores a branch deeply before backtracking, using a stack or recursion.

name: Path Cost g(n)
description: Accumulated cost from the start node to the current node.

name: Queues and Priority Queues
description: Data structures for managing the frontier; priority queues remove the item with the best priority.

name: Heuristic h(n)
description: An estimate of the remaining cost from a node to the goal.

name: Uniform-Cost Search (UCS)
description: Expands the frontier node with the lowest accumulated path cost g(n).

name: Greedy Best-First Search
description: Chooses the frontier node with the lowest heuristic h(n).

name: A* Search
description: Prioritizes nodes using f(n)=g(n)+h(n), combining path cost so far and estimated remaining cost.

name: Admissible and Consistent Heuristics
description: A heuristic is admissible if it never overestimates the true remaining cost. A* with an admissible heuristic returns an optimal path.
